Home.title: From a fuzzy idea to a solid project.
Home.subtitle: Ideaxion first helps you understand your project, then make it solid. For free.
Home.reassurance: No sign-up · 3 minutes · your scorecard across the 12 key dimensions.

private.title: Your idea stays private
private.text: Encrypted, never sold. You control what you share, and with whom.

author.title: You stay the author
author.text: The AI explains and questions — you do the writing. Your project is yours.

noCommit.title: Zero commitment
noCommit.text: Free, no credit card. Start now, leave whenever you want (GDPR).

Home.painTitle: The first pain isn't the lack of money.
Home.painText: It's helplessness: understanding how it works, structuring your project, building a pitch, losing the fear. We build the engine that gets you there.

understand.title: Understand
understand.text: A diagnostic produces your understanding scorecard: essence, viability, scalability.

learn.title: Learn
learn.text: The Workshop explains the business plan, the pitch, the business model — and you build your own version, guided.

practice.title: Practice
practice.text: The pitch simulator makes you face the real questions, fearlessly, as often as you want.

founders.title: Founders
founders.text: Understand, learn, practice — and decide for yourself when to go further.

mentors.title: Mentors
mentors.text: Get picked by the founders you can truly help move forward.

financiers.title: Investors
financiers.text: Only see projects that are genuinely prepared and qualified.

free.a: We build value first. The whole founder journey — diagnostic, academy, simulator — is free. Mentoring and certification come later, once proven.

ai.q: Does the AI do the work for me?
ai.a: No. It explains and questions you; you do the writing. You stay the author of your project — that's how you own it.

maturity.q: What if my idea isn't mature?
maturity.a: That's the ideal starting point. We start from where you are, no judgment.

Home.finalTitle: Your project deserves to be understood before being judged.
Home.finalReassurance: No sign-up · no credit card · your idea stays private.
